title: feat(hugvar): corridor-slide is rounder than nu on B12
science: Not a same-k cell: an exact three-Dijkstra arrival-speed variance comparison on B_12 over all 2624 nonzero sites, with rational second moments Q_mu=81461329283517896329/284940228576113510400, Q_nu=775884178398451/2344690585036800, Q_l1=337/656 and var_mu 0.005602 < var_nu 0.006661 < var_l1 0.009447. Load-bearing: it shows mu is simultaneously a reverser AND strictly rounder than nu, which cuts against the prior band's 'roundness and reversal are decoupled' reading (#6765/#6770). Runner defect: the uniqueness-not-claimed gate is written 'A or B and C' (Python precedence), so its fallback disjunct is a near-tautological substring test.
